title: ThemeContext: defined in grafana-data, supplied by app root, read via useTheme2/useStyles2 in grafana-ui
answers: How does theming flow into grafana-ui components?
Where is ThemeContext defined and provided?
Why doesn't grafana-ui import its own theme provider?
body: `ThemeContext` is defined in `packages/grafana-data/src/themes/context.tsx:6`, not in grafana-ui — grafana-ui just re-exports it (src/index.ts:464) and consumes it via `useTheme2`/`useStyles2` in `packages/grafana-ui/src/themes/ThemeContext.tsx`. The app supplies the actual value once at the root: `public/app/core/utils/ConfigProvider.tsx:81` does `<ThemeContext.Provider value={theme}>`, reacting to a `ThemeChangedEvent` from `@grafana/runtime`. Any change to theming propagation across the app should touch ConfigProvider, not grafana-ui's ThemeContext.tsx.
